{{Improve|February 2020}} {{Hatnote|Not to be confused with [[Sand Crab]]s, recurring enemies in {{TLoZ Series}}, or [[Running Crab]]s, enemies in {{FPTRR}}.}} {{Infobox Species |image= {{Media |Model TWW= File:TWW Crab Model.png |Model TWWHD= File:TWWHD Crab Model.png |Model BotW= File:BotW Ironshell Crab Model.png |Model TotK= File:TotK Bright-Eyed Crab Model.png }} |caption= |pronunciation= |plural= |game= TWW, BotW, TotK |other= AoC, AoI |era= |habitat= {{List|Beaches, Bodies of [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]}} |attack= |weapon= |cost= |value= |characteristics= |members= {{List| * [[Ironshell Crab]] * [[Razorclaw Crab]] * [[Bright-Eyed Crab]] }} |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Crab|Crabs|Series, TWW, TWWHD, BotW, TotK, AoC, AoI|plural}} are recurring creatures in {{TLoZ Series}}. ==Appearances== ==={{TWW|-}}=== {{Descriptions TWW}} In {{TWW}}, Crabs are small, helpless creatures that are found near the [[Water]] on islands across the [[Great Sea]], usually on [[Sand]] but sometimes in [[Grass]]. They are the smallest creatures found in {{TWW|-}}, and are completely harmless. If [[Link]] gets too close to one, it will scatter and disappear into the ground, then resurface once Link is no longer nearby. Crabs are found throughout the beaches of the Great Sea, but are very common on [[Outset Island]]. ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{Main|Bright-Eyed Crab, Ironshell Crab, Razorclaw Crab}} In {{BotW}}, three varieties of Crabs appear throughout [[Hyrule|Hyrule Kingdom]]. These types are the [[Ironshell Crab]], the [[Razorclaw Crab]], and the [[Bright-Eyed Crab]]. They are commonly found throughout [[Necluda]], but can be found on mostly all beaches and rivers in Hyrule Kingdom. They can be used in [[Cooking]] to grant different effects to [[Link]] depending on the Crab used in the dish. [[Ironshell Crab]]s will raise defense when cooked in a meal, [[Razorclaw Crab]]s will raise attack when cooked in a meal, and [[Bright-Eyed Crab]]s will restore [[Stamina]] when cooked in a meal. Crabs can also be eaten raw to restore one of Link's [[Life Gauge|Hearts]]. Crabs of any variety are necessary for cooking certain [[Food]] items: {{Data Table |game= BotW |columns= Meal[Image][Link], Ingredients [List] |- | Crab Omelet with Rice | Any Crab, [[Bird Egg]], [[Hylian Rice]], [[Rock Salt]] |- | Crab Risotto | Any Crab, [[Goat Butter]], [[Hylian Rice]], [[Rock Salt]] |- | Crab Stir-Fry | Any Crab, [[Goron Spice]] |- | Salt-Grilled Crab | Any Crab, [[Rock Salt]] |- }} ====List of Crabs==== {{Data Table Copy |fromPage= Materials in Breath of the Wild |storedAs= Crabs }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Main|Bright-Eyed Crab, Ironshell Crab, Razorclaw Crab}} {{Stub|TotK}} {{Data Table Copy |fromPage= Food in Tears of the Kingdom |storedAs= Meals |excludeColumns= #, Description |rowsWith= crab }} ====List of Crabs==== {{Data Table Copy |fromPage= Materials in Tears of the Kingdom |storedAs= TotK Materials |excludeColumns= Category |rowsWith= Crab }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Main|Bright-Eyed Crab, Ironshell Crab, Razorclaw Crab}} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= AoI |type= Items |category= Items in Age of Imprisonment |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Where the Item is found * What the Item is used for * If the Item is a Weapon, what ways the Weapon can be enhanced }} {{Main|Bright-Eyed Crab, Ironshell Crab, Razorclaw Crab}} {{Stub|AoI}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} {{Ref| {{Cite|Crab|Figurine|TWWHD}} {{Cite|'''Bright-Eyed Crab'''|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}} {{Cite|'''Bright-Eyed Crab'''|Hyrule Compendium|TotK}} {{Cite|{{Big|Bright-Eyed Crab}}
